extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective/new editors attempting to find or create the 'Poking a Dead Frog' article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for locating an existing Wikipedia page or creating a new article when a searched title is missing; covers searching, account/confirmation requirements, and troubleshooting (deletions, delays, redirects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatives if you cannot create an article directly: use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article. (Original text: 'You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles. Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Poking a Dead Frog' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, perform a search to avoid duplication and to find alternative titles or spellings. (Original text: 'Search for "Poking a Dead Frog" in existing articles.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' / backlink tools to discover related content or redirects that may already cover the topic. (Original text: 'Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a missing page might exist under a different capitalization, verify alternative spellings/capitalizations and create or suggest a redirect rather than a duplicate article. (Original text: 'Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge troubleshooting
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a newly created page doesn't appear, wait for database updates or use the purge function to refresh; do not immediately recreate the page. (Original text: 'If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page missing
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate deletion logs to learn whether the title was removed and why before attempting to recreate content; follow guidance in the linked help page about deletions. (Original text: 'If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?')
